hardening_before_execution.issue: Legacy combined-status response completeness is not checked
hardening_before_execution.proposal: GET commits/H/status?per_page=100; assert total_count == len(statuses), then require every status success.

hardening_before_execution.issue: Merge boundary relies on upstream strict collector for detailed tree/parents/event/workflow provenance
hardening_before_execution.proposal: Reassert terminal source/tree/sourceparents/testmerge/testmergetree/reviewedbase and each audited proof workflow/event/run_conclusion/tree/parents using their already proved exact values.

hardening_before_execution.issue: Final PR check does not explicitly reject a hold label newly added after initial snapshot
hardening_before_execution.proposal: Assert no hold label in final ready-PR labels before final base read and merge.

ordinary_merge_API_base_race_note: REST sha pins source only. Existing before/final DEV guards plus actual postmerge parent proof are appropriate; do not claim the REST request atomically pins the base. No requirement to rebase on every later base movement is invented.
